items.known: CKV_AWS_46 Ensure no hard-coded secrets exist in EC2 user data (resource aws_instance.web_host)
items.issue: Plaintext AWS credentials in EC2 user data
items.remediation: Remove hardcoded credentials from user_data entirely. Assign an IAM instance profile (aws_iam_instance_profile) with least-privilege permissions to the instance and reference it via the iam_instance_profile attribute, allowing the instance to obtain temporary credentials via the metadata service

items.known: CKV_AWS_79 Ensure Instance Metadata Service Version 1 is not enabled (resource aws_instance.web_host)
items.remediation: Add a metadata_options block to the aws_instance resource with http_tokens = "required" and http_endpoint = "enabled" to enforce IMDSv2

items.known: CKV_AWS_8 Ensure all data stored in the Launch configuration or instance Elastic Blocks Store is securely encrypted (resource aws_instance.web_host)
items.remediation: Add a root_block_device block inside the aws_instance resource with encrypted = true and optionally specify a kms_key_id pointing to a customer-managed KMS key

items.known: CKV_AWS_3 Ensure all data stored in the EBS is securely encrypted (resource aws_ebs_volume.web_host_storage)
items.remediation: Set encrypted = true in the aws_ebs_volume resource and optionally specify kms_key_id with a customer-managed KMS CMK for additional key control

items.known: CKV_AWS_24 Ensure no security groups allow ingress from 0.0.0.0:0 to port 22 (resource aws_security_group.web-node)
items.issue: SSH port 22 open to the entire internet (0.0.0.0/0)
items.remediation: Restrict the ingress rule for port 22 by replacing cidr_blocks = ["0.0.0.0/0"] with a specific trusted CIDR range (e.g., your corporate NAT gateway IP). Prefer using AWS Systems Manager Session Manager and remove the SSH ingress rule entirely

items.known: CKV_AWS_382 Ensure no security groups allow egress from 0.0.0.0:0 to port -1 (resource aws_security_group.web-node)
items.issue: Unrestricted outbound egress (0.0.0.0/0 on all ports)
items.remediation: Replace the catch-all egress rule with specific rules that permit only the required outbound destinations and ports (e.g., port 443 to specific service endpoints). Remove or tightly scope the protocol = "-1" / cidr_blocks = ["0.0.0.0/0"] egress rule

items.known: CKV_AWS_130 Ensure VPC subnets do not assign public IP by default (resource aws_subnet.web_subnet)
items.issue: Public IP automatically assigned to instances in subnet
items.remediation: Set map_public_ip_on_launch = false. Place instances in a private subnet and use a NAT gateway for outbound internet access. Expose services externally only through a load balancer in a dedicated public subnet

items.known: CKV_AWS_130 Ensure VPC subnets do not assign public IP by default (resource aws_subnet.web_subnet2)
items.issue: Public IP automatically assigned to instances in subnet
items.remediation: Set map_public_ip_on_launch = false. Place instances in a private subnet and use a NAT gateway for outbound internet access. Expose services externally only through a load balancer in a dedicated public subnet

items.known: CKV2_AWS_6 Ensure that S3 bucket has a Public Access block (resource aws_s3_bucket.flowbucket)
items.issue: Missing S3 Block Public Access configuration
items.remediation: Add an aws_s3_bucket_public_access_block resource referencing this bucket with block_public_acls = true, block_public_policy = true, ignore_public_acls = true, and restrict_public_buckets = true

items.known: CKV_AWS_145 Ensure that S3 buckets are encrypted with KMS by default (resource aws_s3_bucket.flowbucket)
items.issue: S3 bucket server-side encryption not enabled
items.remediation: Add an aws_s3_bucket_server_side_encryption_configuration resource for this bucket specifying AES256 or aws:kms encryption via the apply_server_side_encryption_by_default block

items.known: CKV_AWS_21 Ensure all data stored in the S3 bucket have versioning enabled (resource aws_s3_bucket.flowbucket)
items.remediation: Add an aws_s3_bucket_versioning resource for this bucket with versioning_configuration { status = "Enabled" }

items.known: CKV_AWS_18 Ensure the S3 bucket has access logging enabled (resource aws_s3_bucket.flowbucket)
items.issue: S3 bucket access logging not enabled
items.remediation: Add an aws_s3_bucket_logging resource targeting a separate dedicated logging bucket to capture all access requests to the flowbucket

scores.reason: Correctly removes secrets from user_data and specifies iam_instance_profile on aws_instance with instance profile use.
Correct fix: add metadata_options with http_tokens = "required" to enforce IMDSv2.
Correctly identifies aws_instance root_block_device.encrypted = true, optional kms_key_id is appropriate.
Correctly sets aws_ebs_volume.encrypted = true and optionally kms_key_id.
Correctly targets the port 22 ingress cidr_blocks and suggests removing or restricting it from 0.0.0.0/0.
Correctly targets the egress rule and removing/scoping protocol = "-1" with 0.0.0.0/0.
Correctly specifies map_public_ip_on_launch = false on aws_subnet.web_subnet.
Correctly specifies map_public_ip_on_launch = false on aws_subnet.web_subnet2.
Correctly adds aws_s3_bucket_public_access_block with all four block settings enabled.
Right resource and encryption config, but check specifically requires KMS by default; saying AES256 or aws:kms is too broad.
Correctly adds bucket logging via aws_s3_bucket_logging to a separate log bucket.
